Slippery Elm Bark

Remedy slippery-elm mucilage digestive soothing gut-healing

Evidence: traditional

Summary

Soothing herb with high mucilage content that coats and protects the digestive tract.

Indications

  • digestive-discomfort
  • gut-healing
  • acid-reflux
  • irritable-bowel

Contraindications

  • pregnancy

Preparations

  • powder
  • lozenge
  • capsule

Body Systems Affected

  • digestive
  • immune

Treats These Ailments

Conditions listed as treatable by this remedy:

  • Gut Dysbiosis
    Imbalance of beneficial gut bacteria leading to digestive issues and compromised immunity.
  • Acid Reflux / GERD
    Gastroesophageal reflux disease causing heartburn and acid regurgitation.
  • Allergic Rhinitis
    Allergic inflammation of the nasal passages causing sneezing, congestion, and itching.
  • Bronchitis
    Inflammation of the bronchial tubes causing coughing and mucus production.
  • High Blood Pressure
    Chronically elevated blood pressure requiring management.
